text: What name do you want to use at work?
hint: For example, your full name or the name people know you by.

text: How do you describe your work in one sentence?
hint: For example: I help families find the right school.

text: Describe one job, volunteer role, course, or project. What did you do?
hint: Name the place and the time if you want. One activity per answer.

text: Describe another activity that you are proud of.
hint: Paid or unpaid work, study, care work, or a personal project all count.

text: Did you take a break, study, or change direction? Describe it.
hint: Leave it empty if it does not apply.

text: What can you do well? Name one skill.
hint: For example: calm phone support, bookkeeping, or Spanish.

text: Name another skill or a language that you use.
How do you want an AI assistant to help you?
hint: For example: short answers, plain words, or examples first.

text: What do you want to do next?
hint: For example: find a part-time role, or learn a new skill.
